newsitem.title: USA: Periphonics shareholders offer 1.1 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Periphonics shareholders offer 1.1 mln shrs.

text.p: Periphonics Corp said Friday in a registration filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission certain shareholders are selling 1.1 million common shares.
The number of shares reflect the two-for-one stock split in the form of a stock dividend payable on Oct 31 to holders of record on Oct 15, the filing said.
After the offering, the number of outstanding shares will total 13,625,132 common. the filing said.
The stockholders have offered the underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option of up to 165,000 additional common shares. The offering will be made through William Blair & Co and Dain Bosworth Inc.
The Bohemia, New York company develops, builds, markets and supports high performance automated interactive transaction processing systems.
